title: LIVE CHLOROPHYLL / ALGAL ACTIVITY
source_name: NOAA CoastWatch S-NPP VIIRS chlorophyll-a, Science Quality, Global 4 km, Daily (ERDDAP nesdisVHNSQchlaDaily)
log_hint: chlorophyll spans orders of magnitude; percentile anchors handle the skew without log-warping values
what: Chlorophyll-a concentration at the lake surface, a proxy for phytoplankton abundance/biomass. NOT a toxin measurement and NOT a harmful-algal-bloom diagnosis.
why_extreme: Very high values (blooms, algal activity, turbid intrusions) compress into red-violet/deep-purple; common background concentrations own most of the color resolution.
